records.title: Counting
records.definition: The process of determining how many objects are in a collection by assigning numbers in order.
key_ideas: Each object should be counted once.
The final number represents the quantity.
misconceptions: Counting the same object more than once.
assessment_ideas: Count a collection and state its quantity.
sources: Dream Education original synthesis; standard mathematical definitions

records.title: Addition
records.definition: The arithmetic operation of combining quantities to obtain a sum.
key_ideas: The result is called the sum.
principles: Adding zero leaves a number unchanged.
Order does not change the sum.
relationships: Addition is related to counting and subtraction.
questions: What happens when quantities are added?
assessment_ideas: Solve numerical and real-world addition problems.
sources: Dream Education original synthesis; standard mathematical definitions

records.title: Division
records.definition: The arithmetic operation of separating a quantity into equal groups or determining how many times one quantity contains another.
relationships: Division is the inverse of multiplication.
misconceptions: Thinking division by zero produces zero.
assessment_ideas: Solve division problems and sharing situations.
sources: Dream Education original synthesis; standard mathematical definitions
